top_signals.title: Europe’s Low Gas Stocks Set Stage for Winter LNG Battle
top_signals.summary: Europe’s lowest levels of natural gas in storage in nearly two decades risk intensifying the race for LNG supply in the coming months as both Europe and Asia are competing for a shrinking pool of supply, with the Middle East’s LNG still blocked at the Strait of Hormuz.   “The potential for a global ‘fight for fuel’ is there, particularly in a colder winter,” Go Katayama, principal insight analyst for LNG at intelligence firm Kpler, told Bloomberg.
